name: GoodDollar GoodFundManager untrusted staking callback accounting
summary: GoodFundManager.collectInterest accepted arbitrary staking-contract addresses and measured reserve balance changes across calls to those untrusted contracts, so attacker-controlled reserve changes during a callback were misclassified as collected staking interest.

loss.notes: The anchor receipt shows an exact net 625,140.676705135213042766 DAI outflow from Compound's cDAI contract and the same DAI increase at campaign beneficiary 0x6c08f56ff2b15db7ddf2f123f5bffb68e308161b after the reserve's cDAI was redeemed. DAI is valued at stablecoin par. The simultaneously created 14,062,071,177.43 G$ and 10,213,394,244.25 G$X express the accounting failure and inflationary harm but are not added to the DAI reserve loss; later freeze, fee, and burn mitigation is likewise not netted against the transferred DAI.

ageReset.description: The third and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected GoodFundManager implementation 0x4a37a8d7cdb43d89b4dbd7ecfaeaf9bd39e24929.

sources.note: Reviewed the anchor receipt and call trace, the campaign's earlier deployment and setup transactions, the proxy creation trace, all proxy Upgraded logs through the incident, the implementation deployment/runtime bytecode, the official commit-pinned GoodFundManager source, and GoodDollar's incident report. The first successful defect execution is transaction 0x726459...84d0: attacker-controlled staking callback 0x9a5cd1145791b29ac4e68df3bf8e30d2167daa76 reached collectInterest through proxy 0x0c6c80d2061afa35e160f3799411d83bdeea0a5a, which delegated to implementation 0x4a37a8d7cdb43d89b4dbd7ecfaeaf9bd39e24929. The proxy had exactly three Upgraded events before the incident; the final event was log 22 of transaction 0xe710b2...5dce, and the selected runtime hash remained 0x1603edb57ff936d52c7ff4f3696a591f39bf8b46b8e93cf5591de63473bf48ba. Receipt-level net accounting gives 625,140.676705135213042766 DAI transferred from cDAI to campaign beneficiary 0x6c08f56ff2b15db7ddf2f123f5bffb68e308161b. The official report independently identifies the untrusted-input defect, the campaign addresses, reserve loss, and G$ inflation; the exact receipt amount is used instead of its rounded/reported cDAI figure.
